notes.title: 🔴 Demo and Musical Performance - PixelJunk Eden 2
notes.content:
Join us at 5pm JST / 8AM UTC on October 13th for a special Next Fest livestream.

Take a closer look at the PixelJunk Eden 2 demo, followed by an in-studio musical performance from the game's Director and multimedia artist; Baiyon.

If you can't wait until then, make sure to check out the timed exclusive demo that's available right now. Swing and soar through the gardens of Eden and learn the ropes in a new tutorial.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456570/PixelJunk_Eden_2/

notes.title: 🔴PixelJunk Eden 2 Showcase (Gameplay & Musical Performance)
notes.content:
Join us on October 11 at 10am JST for a livestream preview of the PixelJunk Eden 2 Next Fest demo. The demo play-through will be followed by a musical performance from the game's Director and celebrated multimedia artist, Baiyon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333574/62756ed07f945d14aa258f3cedb18dc20238a1ed.jpg[/img]

An exclusive demo for PixelJunk Eden 2 is available now and you're invited to swing into action for an early hands on during Next Fest. Our mesmerising platformer provides a completely unique experience that’s easy to pick up and get lost in. Baiyon provided both art and sound direction for the original PixelJunk Eden, Eden Obscura and PixelJunk Eden 2, breathing life into the gardens of Eden for everyone to enjoy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456570/PixelJunk_Eden_2/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333574/b7d9029690a33eb357635f6077b5b5dfe83c8438.gif[/img]

notes.title: Play the Steam Next Fest demo!
notes.content:
[h2]Join us in the gardens of Eden and celebrate Steam Next Fest in style!
[/h2]
A free demo is now available for PixelJunk Eden 2 and we invite you to explore the sights and sounds of our psychedelic platformer during Next Fest. Cultivate new plants, collect pollen and help seeds to sprout new exotic leaves as you journey to collect 'Spectra' - the source of all life in the biomes of Eden. Go it alone or adventure together with a friend locally in this brand new demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333574/e7c3126d29c6c17b18b5e13e63e5c901c921162b.png[/img]

For players who are new to the PixelJunk Eden series, the demo includes a tutorial that will help you to swing into your first garden with ease.

Join the adventure during Next Fest to explore two unique gardens, available for the first time in full 4K. This stunning demo experience will be available from October 10th until the conclusion of Steam Next Fest on October 16th. 

Please consider adding us to your wishlist and we look forward to your feedback on the demo!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456570/PixelJunk_Eden_2/

Many thanks and we hope you enjoy playing.

Q-Games

notes.title: PixelJunk Eden 2 swings onto PC!
notes.content:
The PixelJunk Eden series is making a return to Steam and we can’t wait to welcome you back to the gardens of Eden. It’s been over 10 years (!!) since the original Eden swung onto PC and now we’re back with a brand new hypnotic adventure for you to enjoy with PixelJunk Eden 2. 

[previewyoutube=v1W8PsDgwyE;full][/previewyoutube]
We just shared our announcement trailer which provides an overview of what’s to come, including 20+ Grimps to discover, a full single player campaign with 2 player co-op and 40+ game altering spices that allow you to customise your adventure and gameplay.

Thank you to everyone that has reached out since our announcement, it really means a lot to us and we can’t wait to share more details in the coming weeks and months. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456570/PixelJunk_Eden_2/

For now, please add us to your wishlist to stay up to date with the latest PixelJunk Eden 2 announcements!

Thanks as always,
Q-Games
